title: Week 11: vs Ravens (There's a lot to like in the Saints win + Observer intern joins the show)
text: The Charlotte Observer's Carolina Panthers beat reporter Alex Zietlow and columnist Scott Fowler discuss the team's win over the Saints to maintain the NFC South lead and what some players' playing time means moving forward (3:15). Then, they bring on Observer sports intern Will Dehmel to talk about his experience covering the Panthers this fall and offer his rest of the season prediction (21:35). Finally, Alex and Scott talk about the Ravens and make their week 11 predictions (31:20). Learn more about your ad choices. Visit megaphone.fm/adchoices
